response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT transref, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_cnt FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY transref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS overall_avg FROM per WHERE avg_cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.transref, p.avg_cnt FROM per p, overall o WHERE p.avg_cnt > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_cnt) AS k_avg FROM kept), res AS (SELECT k.transref, k.avg_cnt AS avg_anlycount, k.avg_cnt - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall, k.avg_cnt - ka.k_avg AS diff_above_kept_avg FROM kept k, overall o, kept_avg ka) SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC) AS rnk FROM res) WHERE rnk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_above_kept_avg DESC

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of the per-transaction averages, where each transaction counts once regardless of how many rows it has. Transactions whose anlycount is all NULL have a NULL average and are excluded from that mean and from the kept set.
'Above' means strictly greater. 'Top 10 plus ties' is implemented with RANK() <= 10 on the difference from the kept-set average, sorted in descending order. The output includes an extra rnk column.
The difference from the kept-set average can be negative for kept transactions that sit below that kept average. These rows are shown as computed.
